mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('studentNo', student.student_no, 'studentName', student.student_name) ORDER BY student.guidance_student_id) FROM student_guidance_students student WHERE student.achievement_id = sg.achievement_id), '[]'::jsonb)

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings scope_mapping WHERE scope_mapping.user_id = #{criteria.viewerUserId} AND scope_mapping.organization_code = sg.organization_code AND scope_mapping.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND scope_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE')

mapper.select: SELECT sg.achievement_id AS "achievementId", sg.management_no AS "managementNo", sg.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", personnel.name AS "teacherName", sg.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", sg.organization_code AS "organizationCode", sg.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", sg.guidance_start_date AS "guidanceStartDate", sg.guidance_end_date AS "guidanceEndDate", sg.certification_status AS "certificationStatus", (sg.attachment_ref IS NOT NULL) AS "attachmentPresent", AS students, sg.created_at AS "createdAt", sg.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM student_guidance_achievements sg LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = sg.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no sg.deleted_yn = 'N' AND sg.management_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.managementNo}, '%') AND sg.management_item_code = #{criteria.managementItemCode} AND sg.guidance_start_date >= #{criteria.guidanceDateFrom} AND sg.guidance_end_date <= #{criteria.guidanceDateTo} AND sg.certification_status = #{criteria.certificationStatus} ORDER BY sg.guidance_start_date DESC, sg.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.safeSize} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_guidance_achievements sg LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = sg.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no sg.deleted_yn = 'N' AND sg.management_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.managementNo}, '%') AND sg.management_item_code = #{criteria.managementItemCode} AND sg.guidance_start_date >= #{criteria.guidanceDateFrom} AND sg.guidance_end_date <= #{criteria.guidanceDateTo} AND sg.certification_status = #{criteria.certificationStatus}

SELECT sg.achievement_id AS "achievementId", sg.management_no AS "managementNo", sg.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", personnel.name AS "teacherName", sg.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", sg.organization_code AS "organizationCode", sg.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", sg.guidance_start_date AS "guidanceStartDate", sg.guidance_end_date AS "guidanceEndDate", sg.certification_status AS "certificationStatus", (sg.attachment_ref IS NOT NULL) AS "attachmentPresent", AS students, sg.created_at AS "createdAt", sg.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM student_guidance_achievements sg LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = sg.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no WHERE sg.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND sg.deleted_yn = 'N'
SELECT organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC, mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE employee_no=#{employeeNo} AND status='ACTIVE' AND system_use_yn='Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE student_guidance_achievements SET management_item_code=#{managementItemCode},guidance_start_date=#{guidanceStartDate},guidance_end_date=#{guidanceEndDate},attachment_ref=#{attachmentRef},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{updatedBy},change_reason=#{changeReason} WHERE achievement_id=#{achievementId} AND certification_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id,upload_id,row_number,row_payload,validation_status) VALUES ('SG-STG-'||#{uploadId}||'-'||#{rowNumber},#{uploadId},#{rowNumber},CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb),#{status})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories (upload_id,total_count,success_count,error_count,saved_count,processor_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId},#{total},#{success},#{error},#{saved},#{userId}) ON CONFLICT (upload_id) DO UPDATE SET total_count=EXCLUDED.total_count,success_count=EXCLUDED.success_count,error_count=EXCLUDED.error_count,saved_count=EXCLUDED.saved_count,processor_user_id=EXCLUDED.processor_user_id,processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_files WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND uploader_user_id=#{userId} AND business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND validation_status='VALIDATED'
SELECT row_payload::text FROM excel_upload_staging_rows WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND validation_status='NORMAL' ORDER BY row_number
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status='COMMITTED' WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId}
mapper.select: SELECT error_id AS "errorId",upload_id AS "uploadId",row_number AS "rowNumber",column_name AS "columnName",input_value AS "inputValue",error_code AS "errorCode",error_reason AS "errorReason",correction_guide AS "correctionGuide" FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY row_number

SELECT f.upload_id AS "uploadId",f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName",f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId",h.total_count AS "totalCount",h.success_count AS "successCount",h.error_count AS "errorCount",h.excluded_count AS "excludedCount",h.saved_count AS "savedCount",h.processing_time_millis AS "processingTimeMillis",h.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM excel_upload_files f JOIN excel_upload_histories h ON h.upload_id=f.upload_id WHERE f.business_type='STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND f.uploader_user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY h.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
